# Veterinary Oncology in New York, NY

New York City pet owners have access to Dr. Impellizeri's world-class veterinary oncology care at two convenient locations — Queens and Manhattan's Upper West Side. Both clinics offer the full range of advanced cancer treatments including chemotherapy, targeted electrochemotherapy with proprietary probes, immunotherapy cancer vaccines, and adoptive T-cell therapy.

Queens & Manhattan Two locations

## Why New York Pet Owners Choose Us

As the only practice in the U.S. offering true multi-modality combination therapy, we treat cancers that other practices simply can't. Patients travel from across the country to our New York locations because Dr. Impellizeri's technology and experience are unmatched.

Two NYC locations — Queens and Manhattan UWS

About This Clinic

Low Cost Vet Mobile is your community's animal rescue veterinary service, proudly providing full-service veterinary care in Fresh Meadows, NY. We’re committed to 'helping those who help animals'.

We offer a wide range of services including surgeries, dentals, spay/neuter procedures, hospitalization, ultrasound, echocardiogram, and chemotherapy at significantly reduced costs. We specialize in advanced cat diagnostics.

What sets us apart is our dedication to affordability – we provide care at ¼ to ½ of market prices! We are also Fear-Free Certified, ensuring a stress-free experience for your pet.

Our team has treated over 51,000 dogs and cats in the past 16 years. Contact us today to learn more about our services and how we can help your beloved companion!

### Our Approach

Cancer diagnosis and treatment is greatly enhanced by a team approach through collaboration with our Specialists in Internal Medicine, Pathology, Surgery, Diagnostic Imaging, and Radiation Oncology.

Our Specialists strive to minimize side effects and optimize tumor reduction to achieve a remission and provide your pet with the best possible quality of life.

iframe

### Treatment

In some cases, surgical removal of tumors, either alone or in combination with other treatments, can control cancer and provide the best quality of life for your pet. Other pets may benefit from the following routinely administered treatments:

  * Chemotherapy
  * Immunotherapy
  * Radiation therapy
  * Investigational therapies (recently an investigational program involving the vaccination of dogs with melanoma has achieved success)
